card.text: Metal-rich asteroid and target of NASA's Psyche mission.

introduction.text: A. De Gasparis found Psyche at Naples in 1852. Its shape is flattened and irregular.

shape.title: SPHERE shape reconstruction
shape.summary: Fitted to sharp images of the whole disc and to light curves, so large hollows can show.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a reference sphere. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.

zimpol.title: ZIMPOL deconvolved imaging
zimpol.summary: Telescope images of the lit surface, placed by the asteroid’s own measured spin. Grey is photographed light, not colour.

thermal-inertia.title: ALMA thermal inertia map
thermal-inertia.summary: How slowly the surface heats and cools, fitted cell by cell to radio thermal images. Coarse cells, large uncertainties.

dielectric-constant.title: ALMA dielectric constant map
dielectric-constant.summary: How metal-rich the upper surface looks to radio waves, fitted cell by cell to the same images. Coarse cells.
